classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round every rank hits `barrier.wait()` and then synchronously `_read_staged(manifest(workdir, r, placing))` before the next `barrier.wait()`, so all ranks are held at the barrier until the slowest rank's single read of that round's file m%d completes (one read per rank per manifest file).

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: After the post-manifest barrier each rank does its own `_read(sidecar(workdir, me, i, placing))` on its private files with no intervening barrier, and the same sidecar index is re-read in each of the 200 rounds.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Each rank synchronously `_read(shard(workdir, me, i), SHARD_BYTES)` on its own shard files outside any barrier region, repeated once per shard for all 200 rounds.
